title: The benefits of boxing
paragraphs: Boxing has been practised for centuries – it was even one of the sports in the original Olympic Games in ancient Greece. More recently, boxing has become mainstream in the UK, with hundreds of thousands of people from all walks of life participating in the sport every week. But why? The answer lies in the physical, mental and even social benefits boxing can bring.

Its physical benefits are clear. Whether it’s practising with a punching bag, sparring with a partner or facing an opponent in the ring, boxing can be an intense form of exercise and give a full-body workout. It can improve muscular strength, and it can also increase anaerobic fitness – allowing someone to work out harder, for longer. These can, in turn, have a positive impact on other aspects of physical well-being, like heart health and weight management.

But the high physical demands of the sport aren’t just good for the body – boxing can also have a positive impact on someone’s mental well-being. Dr Jessica Pinchbeck, Senior Lecturer in Sport and Fitness at the Open University, says that boxing ‘can alleviate some of the symptoms of anxiety and depression’. Exercising regularly is already widely known to be good for mental health, but boxing can also bring a sense of discipline and focus.

And there is a third benefit to putting on the boxing gloves. Practising punches can be done alone, of course, but boxing is not just an individual activity – it also involves working with others to train and stay safe. Dr Gavin Williams, Senior Lecturer in Education at the Open University, says that this cooperation and teamwork can ‘create a sense of identity… and belonging’. So, no matter what the reason that attracts someone to boxing, the interactive elements of the sport, mean it can also have profound social benefits.
Good for body, mind and social interactions? It’s not surprising that more and more people are stepping into the ring.

vocabulary.entry: all walks of life /ɔːl wɔːks əv laɪf/ 各行各业；各界人士
vocabulary.example: The charity event attracted people from all walks of life.
vocabulary.translation: 这场慈善活动吸引了来自各行各业的人。

vocabulary.entry: punching bag /ˈpʌntʃɪŋ bæɡ/ 沙袋
vocabulary.example: He spends 30 minutes every day hitting the punching bag to release stress.
vocabulary.translation: 他每天花30分钟击打沙袋来释放压力。

vocabulary.entry: spar /spɑː(r)/ v. （拳击）轻拳对练；试拳
vocabulary.example: The two boxers spent the afternoon sparring in the gym.
vocabulary.translation: 这两名拳击手整个下午都在健身房里轻拳对练。

vocabulary.entry: opponent /əˈpəʊnənt/ n. 对手；竞争者
vocabulary.example: He defeated his opponent in the final round of the boxing match.
vocabulary.translation: 他在拳击比赛的最后一轮击败了对手。

vocabulary.entry: ring /rɪŋ/ n. （拳击、摔跤等的）赛场；擂台
vocabulary.example: The crowd cheered loudly as the boxer stepped into the ring.
vocabulary.translation: 拳击手踏入擂台时，观众们高声欢呼。

vocabulary.entry: intense /ɪnˈtens/ adj. 高强度的；剧烈的
vocabulary.example: The team faced intense competition in the championship game.
vocabulary.translation: 这支队伍在锦标赛中遭遇了激烈的竞争。

vocabulary.entry: full-body workout /ˌfʊl ˈbɒdi ˈwɜːkaʊt/ 全身锻炼
vocabulary.example: Swimming and boxing are both excellent forms of full-body workout.
vocabulary.translation: 游泳和拳击都是很好的全身锻炼方式。

vocabulary.entry: muscular strength /ˈmʌskjələ ˈstreŋθ/ 肌肉力量
vocabulary.example: Regular weight training can significantly improve your muscular strength.
vocabulary.translation: 规律的力量训练能显著提升你的肌肉力量。

vocabulary.entry: anaerobic fitness /ˌænəˈrəʊbɪk ˈfɪtnəs/ 无氧适能
vocabulary.example: Sprinting and boxing can help enhance anaerobic fitness effectively.
vocabulary.translation: 短跑和拳击能有效提升无氧适能。

vocabulary.entry: in turn /ɪn tɜːn/ 反过来；依次
vocabulary.example: Regular exercise improves physical health, and this in turn boosts mental well-being.
vocabulary.translation: 规律运动能改善身体健康，而这反过来又会提升心理健康。

vocabulary.entry: physical well-being /ˈfɪzɪkl ˈwel biːɪŋ/ 身体健康；生理健康
vocabulary.example: A balanced diet and adequate sleep are essential for maintaining physical well-being.
vocabulary.translation: 均衡饮食和充足睡眠对维持身体健康至关重要。

vocabulary.entry: heart health /hɑːt helθ/ 心脏健康
vocabulary.example: Eating more fruits and vegetables is beneficial to heart health.
vocabulary.translation: 多吃水果蔬菜对心脏健康有益。

vocabulary.entry: weight management /weɪt ˈmænɪdʒmənt/ 体重管理
vocabulary.example: Combining diet control with exercise is the key to successful weight management.
vocabulary.translation: 饮食控制和运动相结合是成功进行体重管理的关键。

vocabulary.entry: mental well-being /ˈmentl ˈwel biːɪŋ/ 心理健康；心理状态良好
vocabulary.example: Spending time in nature can have a positive effect on mental well-being.
vocabulary.translation: 亲近自然能对心理健康产生积极影响。

vocabulary.entry: alleviate /əˈliːvieɪt/ v. 减轻；缓解
vocabulary.example: The new drug can help alleviate the symptoms of arthritis.
vocabulary.translation: 这种新药有助于缓解关节炎的症状。

vocabulary.entry: anxiety /æŋˈzaɪəti/ n. 焦虑；忧虑
vocabulary.example: Listening to soft music can reduce feelings of anxiety.
vocabulary.translation: 听轻音乐可以减轻焦虑感。

vocabulary.entry: depression /dɪˈpreʃn/ n. 抑郁症；抑郁
vocabulary.example: Seeking professional help is important for people suffering from depression.
vocabulary.translation: 寻求专业帮助对抑郁症患者来说很重要。

vocabulary.entry: discipline /ˈdɪsəplɪn/ n. 自律；纪律
vocabulary.example: Learning a new skill requires a lot of discipline and patience.
vocabulary.translation: 学习一项新技能需要很强的自律和耐心。

vocabulary.entry: boxing glove /ˈbɒksɪŋ ɡlʌv/ 拳击手套
vocabulary.example: He put on his boxing gloves and started training with his coach.
vocabulary.translation: 他戴上拳击手套，开始和教练一起训练。

vocabulary.entry: cooperation /kəʊˌɒpəˈreɪʃn/ n. 合作；协作
vocabulary.example: International cooperation is necessary to solve global environmental problems.
vocabulary.translation: 解决全球环境问题需要国际合作。

vocabulary.entry: teamwork /ˈtiːmwɜːk/ n. 团队合作；协作精神
vocabulary.example: The success of the project was due to the excellent teamwork of all members.
vocabulary.translation: 这个项目的成功归功于所有成员的出色团队合作。

vocabulary.entry: sense of identity /sens əv aɪˈdentəti/ 认同感；身份认同感
vocabulary.example: Joining the club helped her develop a strong sense of identity.
vocabulary.translation: 加入这个俱乐部让她产生了强烈的认同感。

vocabulary.entry: sense of belonging /sens əv bɪˈlɒŋɪŋ/ 归属感
vocabulary.example: The friendly atmosphere of the community gives people a sense of belonging.
vocabulary.translation: 这个社区友好的氛围让人们产生了归属感。

vocabulary.entry: interactive element /ˌɪntərˈæktɪv ˈelɪmənt/ 互动元素
vocabulary.example: The interactive elements in the museum make it popular among children.
vocabulary.translation: 博物馆里的互动元素让它深受孩子们的喜爱。

vocabulary.entry: profound /prəˈfaʊnd/ adj. 深远的；深刻的
vocabulary.example: The book had a profound influence on his view of life.
vocabulary.translation: 这本书对他的人生观产生了深远的影响。

sentences.chinese: 答案就藏在拳击能带来的身体、心理乃至社交层面的益处之中。
拳击对身体的益处显而易见。

sentences.english: It can improve muscular strength, and it can also increase anaerobic fitness – allowing someone to work out harder, for longer.
sentences.chinese: 它可以增强肌肉力量，还能提升无氧耐力——让人能够更努力、更持久地运动。

sentences.english: These can, in turn, have a positive impact on other aspects of physical well-being, like heart health and weight management.
sentences.chinese: 而这些益处反过来又会对身体健康的其他方面产生积极影响，比如心脏健康和体重管理。

sentences.english: But the high physical demands of the sport aren’t just good for the body – boxing can also have a positive impact on someone’s mental well-being.
sentences.chinese: 但这项运动对身体的高强度要求，带来的好处可不止于体魄——拳击同样能对人的心理健康产生积极作用。

sentences.chinese: 开放大学运动与健康专业高级讲师杰西卡·平奇贝克博士表示，拳击“能够缓解焦虑和抑郁的部分症状”。

sentences.chinese: 规律运动对心理健康有益，这早已是共识，但拳击还能培养人自律和专注的品质。

sentences.english: And there is a third benefit to putting on the boxing gloves.
sentences.chinese: 戴上拳击手套，还能收获第三种益处。

sentences.english: Practising punches can be done alone, of course, but boxing is not just an individual activity – it also involves working with others to train and stay safe.
sentences.chinese: 击打练习固然可以独自进行，但拳击并非单纯的个人运动——它还需要和他人协作训练，以确保安全。

sentences.english: Dr Gavin Williams, Senior Lecturer in Education at the Open University, says that this cooperation and teamwork can ‘create a sense of identity… and belonging’.
sentences.chinese: 开放大学教育学高级讲师加文·威廉姆斯博士称，这种协作与团队精神能够“塑造认同感……和归属感”。

sentences.english: So, no matter what the reason that attracts someone to boxing, the interactive elements of the sport, mean it can also have profound social benefits.
sentences.chinese: 因此，无论人们被拳击吸引的初衷是什么，这项运动的互动属性都能让它带来深远的社交益处。

sentences.english: Good for body, mind and social interactions?
sentences.chinese: 对身体、心理和社交都有好处？

sentences.english: It’s not surprising that more and more people are stepping into the ring.
sentences.chinese: 越来越多的人踏上拳台，也就不足为奇了。
